title: ACH Batch
oneLiner: Build a bank-ready NACHA ACH payment file from a spreadsheet of payees in the browser, nothing uploaded
customer: US small businesses and bookkeepers paying contractors or payroll by ACH through their bank
revenueModel: Monthly subscription in USD, first file free

evidence.claim: Halfpricesoft sells ezACH desktop software that creates NACHA files for $199 per installation.
PayFile Pro, a paid browser tool that turns a payments CSV into a NACHA file, is listed with a one-time licence of $10 to $75 or credit packs from $10.
Treasury Software sells ACH software for creating NACHA files from spreadsheets, with optional paid maintenance after 90 days.

nextAction: Research. Against: some banks take a plain CSV of ACH payments directly, for example Chase lets business users import a formatted CSV file of ACH payment instructions (https://chase.com/content/dam/chaseonline/en/demos/cbo/pdfs/cbo_csvfile_helpguide.pdf), and PayFile Pro already fills the browser-tool gap cheaply. Legal must check that handling bank account numbers in the browser only is acceptable.
